## About
Oakland Plumbing Experts works out of 957 Jackson St in Oakland. We handle the plumbing problems that are hard to pin down, like leaks you can't see and water lines that stop working.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 20 reviews. One customer wrote that we worked carefully around the property to find a damaged section of water line. Another said the plumber showed up fully prepared and finished without a second visit.

## Services
- Leak detection: We use thermal imaging to track down hidden leaks, like a pinhole leak inside a wall, so the repair can be made in the right spot.
- Water line leaks: Leaks that are hard to locate, like one near the driveway. We work carefully around your property to find the damaged section and get your water running properly again.
- Outdoor faucet problems: Trouble with an outdoor faucet. We'll come out and take care of it.

## FAQ
Q: Can you find a leak inside a wall?
A: Yes. We use thermal imaging to find leaks in walls, which lets us make a spot repair instead of opening up more than we need to.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open every day of the week, Monday through Sunday, from 8 AM to 8 PM.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 957 Jackson St, Oakland, CA 94607.
